subject.title: feat: configure model providers from the Control UI settings page

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this full credential-management and live-probing surface in the core Control UI once the auth-state side effect and proof gap are resolved?
rationale: The branch intentionally expands the core operator UI and gateway protocol into credential mutation and live provider diagnostics, and the protected maintainer label indicates that implementation correctness alone cannot establish product acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor after safety proof
options.body: Accept the core direction after probes become state-neutral and the contributor supplies redacted real-provider Control UI proof.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Limit the initial change to provider key and default-model editing, deferring live probes and targeted logout to smaller follow-up work.

options.title: Decline the core surface
options.body: Keep provider credential management in CLI or plugin-owned workflows rather than expanding the Control UI and gateway contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after safety proof
recommendation.body: Accept the core direction after probes become state-neutral and the contributor supplies redacted real-provider Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available feature-history connection to the probe engine, although final product ownership remains uncertain.
